subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie is a renowned writer.
• Her first published work of fiction was a short story.
• It was called "The Shivering."
• It first appeared in Zoetrope: All-Story in 2002.
prompt: The student wants to identify the title of Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's first published short story. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Renowned writer Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's first published work of fiction was a short story.
choices.B: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's first published short story was called "The Shivering."
choices.C: In 2002, a short story by Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie appeared in Zoetrope: All-Story.
choices.D: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's first published work of fiction appeared in 2002.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it directly accomplishes the stated goal by identifying the title 'The Shivering' as Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's first published short story. This choice synthesizes the most relevant information from the notes—the author's name, the qualifier that it was her first published work, the genre (short story), and crucially, the title itself. By including all these elements in a clear, concise sentence, Choice B provides exactly what the goal requests: identification of the title.
